title: Raspberry Pi blocks changing RAM chips
summary: A forum discussion revealing that Raspberry Pi's bootloader includes hardware validation that blocks or rejects modified RAM chip configurations, preventing users from upgrading or replacing RAM modules on the board.
problem_solved: Raspberry Pi prevents hardware tampering by validating RAM chip configurations at boot time.
why_valuable: Highlights the trade-off between hardware security/warranty protection and user repairability/upgradability in embedded systems.
